title: Uwell Typhos SE Pod Kit
description:
The
Uwell Typhos SE Pod Kit
is a draw-activated pod system with a 2000mAh battery for up to 8 days of use. Features Storm and Waves modes, CoreShield anti-leak technology, and real dual mesh coil pods for rich, smooth flavour.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
2000mAh
Wattage Range:
18-45W
Charging:
USB Type-C
Activation:
Draw-Activated
E-Liquid Capacity:
6mL
Coil Resistance:
Integrated (Real Dual Mesh)
Airflow:
Stepless Adjustable (MTL to RDL)
Power Modes:
Storm Mode / Waves Mode
Display:
3-Colour LED Battery Indicator
Pod Compatibility:
Uwell Typhos Pods (0.3Ω Dual Mesh, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω)
Brand:
Uwell
